title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Illegal Fundraising

articles.content_en:
Article 3: Where illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits falls under any of the following circumstances, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law:
(1) the amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is RMB 1 million yuan or more;
(2) the number of persons from whom public deposits are illegally absorbed or absorbed in a disguised form is 150 or more; or
(3) the illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits directly causes economic losses of RMB 500,000 yuan or more to depositors.
Where the amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is RMB 500,000 yuan or more, or the direct economic losses caused to depositors are RMB 250,000 yuan or more, and any of the following circumstances concurrently exists, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law:
(1) having previously been subjected to criminal investigation for illegal fund-raising;
(2) having been subjected to administrative penalty for illegal fund-raising within the preceding two years; or
(3) causing adverse social impact or other serious consequences.

Article 4: Where illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits falls under any of the following circumstances, it shall be determined as "huge amount or other serious circumstances" as provided for in Article 176 of the Criminal Law:
(1) the amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is RMB 5 million yuan or more;
(2) the number of persons from whom public deposits are illegally absorbed or absorbed in a disguised form is 500 or more; or
(3) illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits directly causes economic losses of RMB 2.5 million yuan or more to depositors.
Where the amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is RMB 2.5 million yuan or more, or the direct economic losses caused to depositors are RMB 1.5 million yuan or more, and the circumstance provided for in Item (3) of Paragraph 2 of Article 3 of this Interpretation concurrently exists, it shall be determined as "other serious circumstances."

Article 5: Where illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits falls under any of the following circumstances, it shall be determined as "especially huge amount or other especially serious circumstances" as provided for in Article 176 of the Criminal Law:
(1) the amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is RMB 50 million yuan or more;
(2) the number of persons from whom public deposits are illegally absorbed or absorbed in a disguised form is 5,000 or more; or
(3) illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits directly causes economic losses of RMB 25 million yuan or more to depositors.
Where the amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is RMB 25 million yuan or more, or the direct economic losses caused to depositors are RMB 15 million yuan or more, and the circumstance provided for in Item (3) of Paragraph 2 of Article 3 of this Interpretation concurrently exists, it shall be determined as "other especially serious circumstances."

Article 6: The amount of illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits shall be calculated based on the full amount of funds absorbed by the actor. Where the actor actively returns the illegally obtained money and makes restitution before public prosecution is initiated, thereby reducing the occurrence of harmful consequences, a lighter or mitigated punishment may be imposed; where the actor returns the illegally obtained money and makes restitution after public prosecution is initiated, this may be considered as a sentencing circumstance as appropriate.
Where illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits is mainly used for normal production and business operations, and the actor is able to refund the absorbed funds before public prosecution is initiated, the actor may be exempted from criminal punishment; where the circumstances are obviously minor and the harm is not significant, the act shall not be treated as a crime.
Where criminal liability is not required to be investigated according to law or the actor is exempted from criminal punishment, the case shall be transferred to the relevant administrative organ according to law.

Article 8: Where the amount of fund-raising fraud is RMB 100,000 yuan or more, it shall be determined as "relatively large amount"; where the amount is RMB 1 million yuan or more, it shall be determined as "huge amount."
Where the amount of fund-raising fraud is RMB 500,000 yuan or more and concurrently has the circumstance provided for in Item (3) of Paragraph 2 of Article 3 of this Interpretation, it shall be determined as "other serious circumstances" as provided for in Article 192 of the Criminal Law.
The amount of fund-raising fraud shall be calculated based on the amount actually defrauded by the actor, and the amount already returned before the case is discovered shall be deducted. The advertising fees, intermediary fees, handling fees, rebates, or expenses for bribery or gifts paid by the actor to carry out fund-raising fraud activities shall not be deducted. Interest paid by the actor to carry out fund-raising fraud activities shall be included in the amount of fraud, except that where the principal has not been returned, the interest may be offset against the principal.

Article 9: Where a person commits the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits and is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and a fine is concurrently or solely imposed, the fine shall be not less than RMB 50,000 yuan but not more than RMB 1 million yuan; where sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, a fine of not less than RMB 100,000 yuan but not more than RMB 5 million yuan shall be concurrently imposed; where sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, a fine of not less than RMB 500,000 yuan shall be concurrently imposed.
Where a person commits the crime of fund-raising fraud and is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, a fine of not less than RMB 100,000 yuan but not more than RMB 5 million yuan shall be concurrently imposed; where sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years or life imprisonment, a fine of not less than RMB 500,000 yuan or confiscation of property shall be concurrently imposed.

Article 10: Without the approval of the relevant competent department of the State, issuing stocks or company or enterprise bonds to unspecified members of society, issuing them in a disguised form by means such as transferring equity, or issuing or disguisedly issuing stocks or company or enterprise bonds to specified targets with the cumulative number exceeding 200 persons, shall be determined as "unauthorized issuance of stocks or company or enterprise bonds" as provided for in Article 179 of the Criminal Law. If a crime is constituted, the offender shall be convicted and punished for the crime of unauthorized issuance of stocks, company bonds, or enterprise bonds.

Article 11: Where a person, in violation of state regulations, issues fund shares without approval upon verification according to law to raise funds, and the circumstances are serious, the person shall be convicted and punished for the crime of illegal business operations in accordance with Article 225 of the Criminal Law.

Article 13: Where funds are illegally absorbed from the public through pyramid-selling means, constituting the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits or the crime of fund-raising fraud, and at the same time constituting the crime of organizing or leading pyramid-selling activities, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions providing for the heavier punishment.

Article 14: Where a unit commits the crime of illegally absorbing public deposits or the crime of fund-raising fraud, the unit shall be fined, and its directly responsible supervisors and other directly responsible persons shall be convicted and punished, in accordance with the standards for conviction and sentencing of the corresponding natural-person crimes provided in this Interpretation.
Article 15: Where previously issued judicial interpretations are inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
